REACHtap or drag
Drag the orange disc to move the middle of the gripper in X / Y (height stays the same). Drag the ▲ up or down to change Z. Or tap a spot: in 3D/Top view the height stays the same, and in Side view a tap sets reach and height. Out of reach? The arm goes to the closest point it can reach.

SETUP

Power the Xenon from a USB brick. All servos start at 90° (home). Fit the horns in the home pose: base facing forward, upper arm straight up, forearm level, gripper half open.

DIRECTIONS & TRIM

If a joint moves the wrong way, flip it. Use trim to fix a horn that sits a few degrees off one spline tooth.
